rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of non-string keys in v1 decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: Previous code restricts stored keys to those that are strings or numbers. The patch removes type checking, allowing keys of any type (except ones matching /^this\$\d+$/) to be assigned as properties on the result object. Since JavaScript object keys are coerced to strings, using objects or other non-string primitives as keys results in unexpected string '[object Object]' keys and loss of key identity.
rawFindings.suggestion: Retain the typeof check ensuring keys are string or number before assigning to result.$. Handle other key types appropriately, for example by skipping or converting carefully.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Input object with a key being an object results in key being '[object Object]' string, losing original key semantics, leading to incorrect decoded result.

rawFindings.title: Unconditional assignment of keys to map in v2 decoder _readMap may cause unintended property key conversion
rawFindings.explanation: Patch removes a typeof check on keys ensuring that only string or number keys are assigned to the map object. After patch, all keys including objects will be assigned as properties on the map object, causing keys to be coerced to strings (e.g., '[object Object]'). This can break maps with non-string keys and cause unexpected behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the typeof check to only assign string or number keys to map properties. Handle other keys appropriately, such as storing in the hidden ES6 Map if supported.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding a map with object keys results in keys being coerced to '[object Object]' string, causing key collisions and incorrect map representation.

rawFindings.title: Test expectation changed for object keys decoded as string keys
rawFindings.explanation: The patch changes test expectation from empty object to an object with the string key 'null'. This reflects the change in decoding behavior where keys not string or number are coerced to strings as object keys, leading to possibly unexpected but consistent results with the implementation changes.
rawFindings.suggestion: Review if this new expectation matches intended behavior, or consider adjusting decoding code so that keys are not coerced in this way if original semantics are desired.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding an empty or null key map results in object containing a '[object Object]'-like string key instead of empty or omitted key.

rawFindings.title: Test expectation changed for decoded map with object key to string key
rawFindings.explanation: Patch changes the expected decoded plain object to have string key '[object Object]' instead of empty object. This result is consistent with the change in decoder treating all keys as property keys coerced to strings, causing object keys to produce '[object Object]'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Verify test expectations are correct given decoder changes and intended decoding behavior.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding map with non-string key produces incorrectly coerced string key leading to key collisions or data loss.
